items.raw_excerpt: 7月23日，即梦AI联合抖音电商、艾菲奖共同发起 “AI 广告爆改大赛”，邀请网友围绕经典广告语、经典广告场景和大众记忆中的品牌内容，使用 AI 技术进行创意改编与视频创作，让经典广告焕发全新生命力。 艾菲奖是国际上具有影响力的实效营销与广告传播奖项体系之一，每年持续认可和表彰最具实效的品牌，营销机构及代理机构。作为本次大赛官方合作发起方，艾菲奖的加入为赛事增添了专业度与行业影响力。 本次大赛由李诞发起，经典广告等您来演 本次大赛获得王老吉、旺旺、玛氏、喜之郎、优乐美、溜溜梅、卡姿兰等多个知名品牌授权，聚焦 “经典回忆” 与 “品牌焕新” 两大方向，设置了品牌赛道与公益赛道等五个创作方向。参赛者可围绕熟悉的广告语、经典场景等进行剧情爆改、脑洞续写、公益表达等多元创作，探索 AI 技术在广告创意中的更多可能。 创作形式上，大赛分为“演绎爆改”和“创意手搓”两个类型。前者主要面向即梦 App 端，创作者可借助分身演绎、一键跟拍等能力生成12秒以内短视频；后者面向即梦 Web 端，鼓励创作者通过剧情反转、视觉特效、完整故事设定等方式，制作12秒以上创意视频。参赛作品需在抖音平台及对应即梦端内发布，并带上大赛主话题及赛道话题。 本次赛事投稿时间将持续至 8月20日，并于8月28日公布最终获奖名单。大赛专业评审团将从用户喜爱、创新能力、技术水平、故事设定、视听表达等维度进行综合评选，最终评选出117条优秀作品。各赛道获奖者将获得现金激励、即梦 AI 积分及艾菲奖荣誉证书等奖励。 即梦 AI 相关负责人表示，广告创作是 AI 视频能力落地的重要场景之一，此次联合抖音电商和艾菲奖发起AI广告爆改大赛，是希望借助品牌经典内容为创作者提供具体实践场景，探索AI 创作在广告创意表达中的实际应用。 雷峰网 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: On July 23, the Seed Edge team officially launched the Seed STEM Scientist Program. The program plans to invite 100 scholars from cutting-edge scientific fields to collaborate with the Seed team on real-world research problems, identify and tackle research-level challenges, and explore the potential of AI in accelerating scientific discovery. In recent years, large models have made significant progress in tasks such as general question answering, coding, and mathematical reasoning, but they still face more complex challenges in real scientific research. Against this backdrop, the Seed Edge team initiated the Seed STEM Scientist Program. It is understood that the program focuses on AI research in science, and participating scholars will work alongside the Seed team to conduct more creative scientific exploration. The program has corresponding expectations for participants' research backgrounds and AI experience, hoping that scholars have obtained or are pursuing a PhD in STEM-related disciplines, possess deep academic knowledge and a thorough understanding of their fields, hold a strong interest and firm belief in AI-accelerated scientific discovery, and can clearly assess the application value and current capability boundaries of AI in their disciplines. At the same time, participants are expected to deeply use AI as a productivity tool in their daily research work. Scholars in relevant fields can choose to join the project as scientist advisors or doctoral interns based on their circumstances. It is reported that the first phase of the STEM Scientist Program will last approximately 6 months, during which participating scholars must work at the Seed office alongside the team.

En los últimos años, los grandes modelos han logrado avances significativos en tareas como preguntas y respuestas generales, código y razonamiento matemático, pero aún enfrentan retos de mayor complejidad en problemas reales de investigación. En este contexto, el equipo Seed Edge lanzó el plan Seed STEM Científicos. Según se informa, el plan se centra principalmente en la IA en el ámbito científico.

items.title: 腾讯混元组织架构再升级，合并大语言模型和多模态团队，加速模型研发

It also uses Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that helps AI agents securely connect to diverse data sources and tools through a unified interface. We cover the solution overview, the rationale for selecting the underlying technology stack, lessons learned, and the business impact the solution created at Jefferies.
